function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

Sure! Here’s a quick overview of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide:

| Company (Country) | Notable Vaccines & Platforms |
|-------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** (USA/Germany) | mRNA COVID‑19 vaccines (Comirnaty), influenza, RSV candidates |
| **Moderna** (USA) | mRNA COVID‑19 vaccine (Spikevax), flu, RSV, malaria research |
| **Johnson & Johnson/Janssen** (USA) | Ad26.COV2.S COVID‑19 vaccine; adenovirus vector platform |
| **AstraZeneca** (UK/Sweden) | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222) COVID‑19 vaccine; HPV, meningitis |
| **Novavax** (USA) | Protein subunit COVID‑19 vaccine (NVX-CoV2373); influenza, RSV |
| **Sinovac Biotech** (China) | Inactivated SARS‑CoV‑2 vaccine (CoronaVac); hepatitis B, polio |
| **Sinopharm** (China) | Inactivated SARS‑CoV‑2 vaccine (BBIBP-CorV); various traditional vaccines |
| **Bharat Biotech** (India) | Covaxin (SARS‑CoV‑2 whole‑virus inactivated); typhoid, rotavirus |
| **Serum Institute of India** (India) | Polio, measles–mumps–rubella, Japanese encephalitis, Hepatitis B, etc.; also manufacturing Covishield (Oxford/AstraZeneca) |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** (UK) | Varicella zoster virus (Shingles), pneumococcal conjugate, HPV, influenza |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** (France) | Influenza, rabies, yellow fever, dengue, Hib, pertussis |
| **Merck KGaA / MSD** (Germany/US) | Meningococcus C, HPV, varicella, shingles, influenza |
| **Curevac** (Austria) | DNA-based HIV vaccine candidate; exploring other platforms |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** (Japan) | Rotavirus, enterotoxigenic E. coli, Shigella, influenza |

### How to Find More Details:
If you’d like deeper insights—such as clinical trial phases, production capacities, or recent regulatory approvals—just let me know which company(s) interest you, and I’ll dig up more specifics!

Feel free to ask anything else related to vaccines or their manufacturers.
